latest.description: Bitcoin, gold and technology stocks fall as the yen rallies, while oil prices and government bond yields climb globally.

latest.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth $27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens
latest.description: Duties on U.S. steel and aluminum products have doubled to 50% as a war of words between Washington and Ottawa continues.

latest.title: Crypto platforms have lost over $3.63 billion to cyberattacks — even though most of them did security checks
latest.description: More than 60% of cryptocurrency platforms that lost money due to cyberattacks had undergone independent security audits, CoinGecko said.

latest.title: Cronos confirms $9.2M slipped away before Tectonic exploit rollback
latest.description: Cronos’s post-mortem put the Tectonic exploit’s affected borrowing at $120.4 million, with 7.6% transferred off-network before validators intervened.

latest.title: Treasury yields tick higher as traders look ahead to more economic data releases
latest.description: Treasury yields moved higher as investors look ahead to more key economic data releases this week.

latest.title: Global shipping authorities warn of maritime trade breakdown amid geopolitical turmoil
latest.description: Eighteen maritime bodies warned Tuesday that geopolitical tensions and a growing shadow fleet threaten to undermine international shipping and weaken trade.

latest.description: Mistral is betting on open-weight AI models to help it compete with players like OpenAI and Anthropic.

latest.title: Swiss stablecoin sandbox enters testing phase, adds two new partners

latest.title: Bit2Me sets up specialized unit to help law enforcement track down crypto assets
latest.description: The unit formalizes past operations, building on 1.5 million euros in seized crypto the exchange processed in 2025 for agencies including Interpol and Europol.

latest.description: Canada had condemned Iran’s "destabilizing actions" in the Middle East, saying that it would work with partners to maintain significant pressure on Iran.

latest.title: Australia says it removed 45 crypto, remittance registrations over the past year
latest.description: AUSTRAC said its yearlong sweep included canceled, suspended and unrenewed registrations, while its action against GetCoins helped disrupt organized investment scams.

latest.title: Cholesterol drug setback casts doubt over multibillion-dollar race
latest.description: Novartis’ failure raises the stakes for Amgen and Eli Lilly in the race to turn lower Lp(a) levels into fewer heart attacks and strokes.

latest.title: China's imports in August miss estimates as calls for rebalancing trade grow

latest.title: Liquid Network gets back 3,400 bitcoin from whitehat hackers; talks underway for the rest

latest.title: Bitcoin slips under $79,000, Zcash leads losses as Fed hike odds hold near 60%
latest.description: Every major token fell on Tuesday, though most keep weekly gains, with traders pricing a 60% chance of a Fed hike next week.
